## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 412 captures during November 2019. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and indicates the volume submitted for image assessment and subsequent grading. The clinic should continue to ensure that all completed examinations are recorded promptly and that any operational issues affecting capture activity are communicated through the usual service arrangements.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable images, representing an ungradable rate of 4.4 per cent. This measure should be monitored alongside local equipment and examination processes to identify any recurring factors affecting image quality. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support route.

## Grading

Grading identified 63 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. This provides an overview of grading timeliness for the month and should be considered with the activity and image-quality measures when reviewing site performance. Continued attention to image quality and timely submission will support efficient review and follow-up of results.
